description: This file defines the interface 'TbTransactionalCache' which provides cache operations such as get, put, evict, and transaction management, including methods for fetching data from a database with cache integration.

classes.name: TbTransactionalCache
classes.description: Interface for a transactional cache with methods for cache management and database fetch integration.

methods.name: getCacheName
methods.description: Returns the name of the cache.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache value wrapper for a given key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Puts a value into the cache with the specified key.

methods.name: putIfAbsent
methods.description: Puts a value into the cache only if the key is not already present.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Removes a specific key from the cache.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Removes a collection of keys from the cache.

methods.name: evictOrPut
methods.description: Evicts a key or puts a value if not present.

methods.name: newTransactionForKey
methods.description: Creates a new cache transaction for a specific key.

methods.name: newTransactionForKeys
methods.description: Creates a new cache transaction for a list of keys, considering Redis cluster slot control.

methods.name: getOrFetchFromDB
methods.description: Fetches a value from cache or database, with options to cache nulls and control cache insertion.

methods.name: getAndPutInTransaction
methods.description: Fetches a value from cache or database, and puts it into a transaction.

methods.name: getAndPutInTransaction
methods.description: Fetches a value from database, applies transformations, and caches it within a transaction.

methods.name: getOrFetchFromDB
methods.description: Fetches a value from cache or database with transformation functions, cache control, and transaction management.
